title: Signed envelope base
description: Fields every E0 wire object carries (plan: 'Wire contracts'). signature is opaque in E0 (E1 verifies it). subject_digest = sha256 of the RFC 8785 canonical bytes of the object with signature removed.

type.description: wire object type name, e.g. StageReceipt

issuer.description: the identity that issued this object; a principal, never a platform name

nonce.description: single-use per (run_id, nonce); consumed atomically by the host before dispatch (E3)

key_id.description: identifies the signing key; E0 does not resolve it to a trust root

signature.description: opaque in E0; not verified until E1
